sentences.text:
on 26 July, 2019
 The Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S.Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4430 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioners, who are A-1 and A-2, in F.I.R.No.104 of 2019 on the file of Duggirala Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 420, 270, 272, 273 and 328 I.P.C. and Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in a similar case, this Court, by virtue of a common order in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein by considering that transportation of Gutka is not attracted by the offences alleged under Sections 188, 270 and 273 I.P.C. and FSS Act.
A perusal of the order shows that this Court, by considering that transportation of Gutka does not attract the offences alleged, quashed the proceedings.

4. Hence, following the said order and in terms thereof, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners/A-1 and A-2 in F.I.R.No.104 of 2019 on the file of Duggirala Police Station, Guntur District are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous applications pending, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.

B/O AMD THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE D.V.S.S.SOMAYAJULU CRIMINAL PETITION No.4430 of 2019 Date: 26.07.2019 AMD Chadalavada Nageswara Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 26 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15958895/
